# Team Axiogen

> AI & Digital Engineering Studio from India

Team Axiogen is an AI and digital engineering studio based in Kolhapur and Sangli, Maharashtra, India. We engineer intelligent software systems, bespoke AI models, full-stack web and mobile platforms, cybersecurity architectures, and high-performance cloud solutions.

## What We Do

- **AI & Machine Learning**: Custom AI models, neural networks, NLP systems, computer vision, and generative AI solutions
- **Full-Stack Web Development**: Next.js, React, Node.js, and modern web architectures
- **Mobile App Development**: Cross-platform and native mobile applications
- **Cybersecurity**: AI-powered security systems, penetration testing, and secure architecture design
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Scalable cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments
- **Brand Identity & Design**: Logo design, visual systems, typography, and complete brand guidelines
- **E-Commerce Solutions**: Shopify, custom storefronts, and payment integrations
- **Student Projects**: Final year projects, mini projects, research implementations with documentation

## Our Clients & Sectors

We work across healthcare, fintech, e-commerce, education, SaaS, real estate, media, hospitality, and government sectors — serving startups, enterprises, and academic institutions.
